title: PRIVATE TOUR SWITZERLAND
route: Zurich - Rhine Falls - Lucerne - Bern - Grindelwald - Lauterbrunnen - Zermatt - Blausee - Interlaken

includes: 3/4 Star Hotel (with International Breakfast) - 2 Nights at Zurich > 2 nights at Bern > 1 Night at Tasch > 1 Night in Bern
Private Airport Transfer (MPV or Van) - D1 & D7
Transportations in Switzerland via Private Transport (MPV or Van) - D2 - D6
FREE Train Transfer Tasch to Zermatt
excludes: Fees for others or optional activities

seasons.label: Peak Season
seasons.period: 20 December 2025 - 10 January 2026 · 1 - 28 February 2026 · 15 July 2026 - 15 August 2026 · 20 December 2026 - 3 January 2027 · 1 - 28 February 2027 · 15 July 2027 - 15 August 2027
seasons.rate: Add on RM200 per person per night

seasons.label: Last Minute Surcharge
seasons.rate: 2 pax: Additional RM700 per person · 3 pax & Above: Additional RM500 per person

itinerary.title: Rhine Falls-Zurich
activities: Rhine Falls (The largest waterfall in Europe)
Zurich Old Town (Historic building & cobblestones alley)
Lindenhof (Churches with scenice view, CLOY film location)
Burkliplatz (Oldest bridge in Zurich, CLOY film location)

itinerary.title: Engelberg-Lucerne
activities: Engelberg & Mount Titlis (360 Rotair Cable Car) - optional
Lucern Old Town (Historic building & shopping street)
Chapel Bridge (The famous old wooden bridge)

itinerary.title: Grindelwald-Lauterbrunnen-Murren
activities: Birg & Schilthorn (James Bond film location) - optional

itinerary.title: Tasch-Zermatt
activities: Train from Tasch Zermatt (Panoramic train ride)
Matterhorn (One of the highest summits in the Alps and Europe, the Tobelerone mountain) - optional
Gornergrat (The mountain with magnificent view of the Matterhorn) - optional
Check in hotel - Tasch or Visp

expect.title: Private Transport
expect.body: 7 days full using of private transport.

expect.title: 3/4 Star Hotel
expect.body: With breakfast, near to city centre.

expect.title: Luggage Allocations
expect.body: Please bring max 1 luggage for 1 pax as it will affect the car capacity.

expect.title: Drop & Pick Up
expect.body: Some places will be drop and pickup basis, the driver will guide/communicate before drop off and pickup.

expect.title: Entrance Fees
expect.body: View from outside the attraction place is free but going in might require fees.

expect.title: Malaysian Driving Guide
expect.body: Guide will be waiting at Zurich Airport upon arrival and will be together until the last day (departure).
